title: Grace
description: Grace is getting God's love and forgiveness as a free gift — not because we earned it, but because of who he is.

waypoints.title: A Free Gift
waypoints.body: No one can earn their way to God -- not by being good enough, trying hard enough, or knowing enough. Salvation is a gift, freely given, received simply by trusting Jesus.

waypoints.title: Unearned Kindness
waypoints.body: Can you think of a time someone showed you grace -- kindness you didn't earn? How did it feel?
